SELECT t.id, t.task_name, t.task_type, t.job_id, t.cron_expression, t.status, t.source_datasource_id, t.is_cross_db, t.target_datasource_id, t.target_table_name, t.auto_create_table, t.write_mode, t.batch_size, t.timeout_seconds, t.alarm_email, t.executor_block_strategy, t.last_run_time, t.last_run_status, t.last_run_msg, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, sds.datasource_name AS source_datasource_name, tds.datasource_name AS target_datasource_name FROM job_stat_task t LEFT JOIN job_jdbc_datasource sds ON t.source_datasource_id = sds.id LEFT JOIN job_jdbc_datasource tds ON t.target_datasource_id = tds.id
AND t.task_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{taskName}, '%')
AND t.task_type = #{taskType}
AND t.status = #{status}
AND (t.source_datasource_id = #{datasourceId} OR t.target_datasource_id = #{datasourceId})
AND t.target_table_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{tableName}, '%')
ORDER BY t.id DESC
